TCS client data exposed in fictional breach scenario

SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: this is a fictional scenario written for automated tests and describes no real event.

In this invented scenario, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) told a fictional client, Northwind Mutual Bank, that a data breach at a subcontractor exposed customer records stored in a test environment.

The imaginary incident was detected by the TCS security operations team in Pune after unusual traffic was observed over a weekend, according to the fictional statement.

Northwind Mutual Bank said it was reviewing its contract and could seek damages of $12 million if the investigation confirms negligence by the vendor.

Analysts quoted in the scenario said the episode could weigh on TCS margins in the banking vertical, although revenue guidance was left unchanged.
